soldier: Five pairs of setae on the dorsum of the head near the median ridge. Mandibles sickle-shaped; the left mandible 0.48–0.51 times the head length and about 0.57–0.62 times the greatest head width; a pointed tooth at one-third of the anterior part of the left mandible, its apex directed obliquely towards a small tooth on the right side, the mandibular body behind the tooth about twice as wide as the anterior mandibular body, and a vestige of a small tooth remaining between the tooth and the mandibular basal projection; the right mandible with two fine teeth on its inner side. Antennae with 17 segments, segment 3 the shortest. The middle section of the postmentum is nearly parallel on both sides, and in lateral view its height is about one-sixth of the head height. The pronotum is about 1.46–1.58 times as wide as long, with concavities at the middle of both the anterior and the posterior margin, and with distinct lateral muscle scars.
